description: Soft99 Authentic Premium Wax 200g | Deep gloss & waterproof protection. Includes applicator sponge & detailing brush. Natural carnauba formula. - Distributed/Packaged by Soft99. Product Details: Soft99 Authentic Premium, 200g This product is a high-quality wax-cream with a high percentage of pure Carnauba wax. The carnauba wax forms a transparent protective layer on top of the car paint and gives it an excellent gloss. The wax cream can be spread easily and it leaves an even and thin protective layer. Perfect results for all colours and kinds of paints. Attention!! The product does not contain any abrasives. Results may vary depending on the state of the treated area. Before using the wax cream, you need to clean the car paint with cleaning clay. Then smooth it out with a suitable abrasive. Use: 1. Clean the paint with an adequate car shampoo. 2. Apply wax cream with a sponge. 3. Let it dry for 10-15 minutes, then take off the remaining product with a clean and dry cloth. Note: * Product might dry out quickly during the summer. It is recommended to treat car parts one after another.
